system.description:
AUDITORY EMOTION ORC

An Orc does not whisper the name of a fallen companion. They make certain that everyone on the battlefield hears it.
Whenever you use Death Chant, you may choose up to two conscious allies within 30 feet who can hear you.
Until the end of their next turn, each chosen ally gains a +1-status bonus to attack rolls against the creature that caused the triggering damage, provided that creature is known to you.
This is in addition to the normal benefits of Death Chant.
A creature may benefit from Chorus of the Fallen only once per day.

Prerequisites Death Chant, Level 5

Works through Death Chant's Use: choose up to two allies — each gets +1 status to attacks against the attacker until the end of their next turn (an effect with the attacker's uuid).
